findings.rewrite: One kind is grown men, tenters (machine minders).
findings.problem: "grown up" means adults; "grown men" adds a gender the original does not state.
findings.fix: One kind is adults, tenters (machine minders).

findings.original: modern industry, on the other hand, through its catastrophes imposes the necessity
findings.rewrite: modern industry, through its very catastrophes, makes it necessary
findings.problem: "very" adds an emphasis Marx does not make.
findings.fix: modern industry, through its catastrophes, makes it necessary

findings.original: to snatch from his hands his means of subsistence,[^227] and, by suppressing his detail-function
findings.rewrite: to snatch his means of subsistence out of his hands by taking away his instruments of labor,[^227] and to make him superfluous
findings.problem: After the reordering, the Shakespeare note ("the means whereby I live") is anchored to "instruments of labor" instead of "means of subsistence".
findings.fix: We have seen how it constantly threatens, by taking away his instruments of labor, to snatch his means of subsistence out of his hands,[^227] and to make him superfluous by suppressing his detail-function.

notes_review: The logged calls are sound, including "tenters (machine minders)", the corrected "labor-power" in n. 221, keeping "nec plus ultra" for the pun, and the mention-vs-use treatment of "home-labour"/"home-work". Note 21 says n. 240 was kept exactly as printed, but the closing straight quote was silently made curly; this is harmless typography.
summary: Fidelity is high: every claim, figure, attribution and quotation survives, and Marx's irony (the capitalist's "abstinence", the "tender-hearted" Parliament) is intact. Readability is good, with only three small slips: an added gender, an added emphasis, and one misplaced footnote marker.
